methodology.coverage_caveat: These are path/line/attribute inventories, not executed coverage or proof that code paths run.
methodology.diff_accounting: git diff --numstat BASE..HEAD, separately grouped to expose added experiment/infrastructure cost; this supports no net LOC reduction claim.
methodology.line_kinds: Physical splitlines; blank means whitespace-only; comment_only_lines begins with //, /*, *, or */ after indentation; other_lines is residual. Attribute metrics count attribute lines; static_declaration_lines counts line-start static declarations.
methodology.path_kind: test_path means /tests/ component, tests.rs/test.rs, or *_tests.rs. examples and benches are separate. All other tracked Rust is production_path; inline cfg(test) bodies remain in the containing path bucket.
methodology.rust_scope: Tracked .rs files from each Git tree; baseline files read from the requested archive and SHA-256 verified against git show for every tracked Rust file; HEAD read from a clean worktree.

facts_generated_from_existing_sources: authored Type from syntax PropertySpec, derived from core descriptor AuthoredTypeHint
runtime kind from engine PROPERTY_REGISTRY binding

Applies to from core Applicable / built-in actor catalog
manual_facts_retained: docs-only grouping/category order maps each property name to one section
prose, examples, legend explanations, and scene/internal-only exception explanations
not_removed: engine runtime binding rows remain a separate required source for storage/default/read-source/flags; not duplicate authored-type metadata

topology.status: complete; retain baseline; grouped and shared-CLI both rejected

measurement_definition.critical_path: Observed Plan job creation through CI Required completion.
measurement_definition.runner_minutes: Sum of job started_at-to-completed_at minutes; not billing-rounded.
measurement_definition.first_failure: No failures occurred; first-failure feedback is null/unmeasured.

topology.conclusion: Keep baseline. Grouped is 17.247% slower on median critical path despite 8.028% fewer runner minutes. Shared-CLI is 3.568% slower and uses 3.454% more runner minutes.
causal_and_confounding_notes: Grouped native checks serialize in Native Grouped before CI Required; median aggregate gate-step work falls from 4001s to 3735s while critical-path median rises from 1177s to 1380s.
Ubuntu 24 image revisions 20261111.127.1 and 20261111.370.1 and AMD EPYC/Intel Xeon hosts varied across the nine runs; hosted environment variation confounds small differences.
Shared-CLI producer/consumer artifact handoff succeeded in all selected runs.

compact_summary.evidence_model: adoption uses observed Plan creation to CI Required completion; inferred_active_path_seconds uses the declared dependency graph and per-job ready=max(created_at, parent completion)
notes: All nine workflow_dispatch runs use the same SHA and completed the selected matrix with CI Required success. Build and Check for changes were skipped in every run; no publish occurred.

Plan environment probes are not the declared gate shell, so their failed probes are not toolchain evidence. Gate environment probes on the active paths are valid; host/toolchain records come from those gate artifacts.

No job failed, so first-failure feedback is unmeasured. The shared CLI producer-consumer handoff succeeded. Grouping reduced total gate-step work but moved the critical path to serialized Native Grouped.
